# HandleDuplicate

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Creates a second handle to the same object, with the same or fewer permissions.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x08` SVC_MANAGEHANDLE | `MNGHNDL_DUPLICATE (0)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
SvcResult HandleDuplicate(Handle h, HandlePerms perms, Marker marker);
```

**Registers:** `(h, perms, marker) -> r0 status, r1 new handle`

`marker` is only applied when `h` is a port owned by the caller's space; a server uses it to tell its callers apart. Any other handle keeps its current marker. HandleDup() is the easier form.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) to duplicate. |
| `perms` | in | Permissions for the copy; intersected with those of `h`. |
| `marker` | in | [Marker](../types.md#marker) for the copy (own ports only). |

## Returns

r0 is the status; r1 the new handle on success.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `h` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../errors.md#err_nomem) | The caller's handle table is full. |
